sections.end_condition: Artie makes his first rival and barely escapes a forced duel.

scenes.transition_out_text: The guards usher Artie through the gate, their eyes fixed on his glowing status.

scenes.outcome: Artie understands his 'broken' stat makes him a target for the powerful.

scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps out of the tavern into the bright midday sun of the square.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie makes his first rival and barely escapes a forced duel.

sections.title: The Safe Zone?

scenes.outcome: Artie is stuck with a lighthouse-beacon for monsters.

scenes.transition_in_text: The bell above the pawn shop door jingles as Artie enters.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie leaves the shop, the trophy still glowing brightly in his pack.

scenes.outcome: Artie successfully crits a lock, causing it to explode into gold dust.

scenes.transition_out_text: The explosion of the lock leaves a single item floating in the air.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.

scenes.transition_out_text: Artie heads toward the outskirts of town, avoiding eye contact with everyone.

sections.title: Shopping for Scraps

sections.end_condition: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.

scenes.outcome: Artie begins to treat the world like a rhythm game.

scenes.transition_in_text: The air turns cold as Artie descends the stone stairs.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps into the first large hall, his cloak glowing in the dark.

scenes.outcome: Artie survives his first ranged encounter and gains confidence.

scenes.transition_in_text: A skeletal archer notches a notched arrow in the distance.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie moves deeper into the crypt, toward a room filled with treasure chests.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.

scenes.transition_in_text: Artie corners a group of skeletons near a large chest.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hears the sound of heavy boots echoing from the balcony above.

sections.title: The Crypt of Bad Math

sections.end_condition: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.
sections.intent: Reintroduce Vane as a persistent threat.

scenes.outcome: Artie sees the gap between a 'proper' build and his own.
scenes.summary: Vane enters the crypts with a full party, clearing rooms with ease while Artie hides in a sarcophagus.

scenes.transition_out_text: Vane's party leaves the room, leaving a glowing orb on a pedestal.

scenes.outcome: Artie decides to take the risk and summon the boss for the massive XP.

scenes.transition_in_text: Artie approaches the obsidian pedestal with a mix of fear and greed.
scenes.transition_out_text: The red orb shatters, and the floor begins to shake violently.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.
scenes.outcome: The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.

sections.title: The Rival's Shadow

chapters.stakes_shift: Survival shifts from luck to tactical exploitation of the System's bugs.
chapters.title: The Glass Cannon's Guide to Not Dying
Math-Boss vs. The Glitch
chapters.goal: Survive the Floor Guardian and secure the first major loot drop.
chapters.stakes_shift: If Artie wins, he becomes the first Level 10 'Anomaly'; if he loses, it's Game Over.

bridge.from_prev: The Bone Golem is ready to smash Artie.
bridge.to_next: Artie leaves the crypts with a legendary-tier item that he can't actually use yet.

sections.title: The Dance of Death
sections.intent: A high-octane fight where Artie must dodge every single attack.
sections.end_condition: The floor collapses, trapping the Golem in a hole.

scenes.summary: Artie uses the Crypt environment to kite the Bone Golem, using 'Crit-Punches' to chip away at its armor.
scenes.outcome: The Golem's armor is shattered, but Artie is running out of stamina.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Bone Golem's fist smashes into the stone where Artie stood a second ago.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's next punch bounces off the Golem's core with a dull thud.

scenes.summary: Fizz discovers that the Golem has a 'Crit-Resist' buff, making Artie's main weapon useless.
scenes.outcome: Artie must find a way to bypass the resistance or die.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz's voice crackles in Artie's ear as the Golem readies another strike.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie dives between the Golem's legs, aiming for the floor tiles.

scenes.summary: Artie attempts to 'Crit' the ground beneath the Golem, hoping for a physics glitch.
scenes.outcome: The floor collapses, trapping the Golem in a hole.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's fist connects with a hairline fracture in the stone floor.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The floor collapses, trapping the Golem in a hole.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stands at the edge of the pit, winding up his arm for the final blow.

sections.title: The Final Blow
sections.intent: Resolve the boss fight with a comedic but effective exploit.
sections.end_condition: Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.

scenes.summary: While the Golem is stuck, Artie spends five minutes 'charging' a punch, which the System interprets as a 'Heavy Attack'.
scenes.outcome: Artie prepares his most powerful hit yet.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stands at the edge of the pit, winding up his arm.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's fist connects with the Golem's skull with a high-pitched 'ding'.

scenes.summary: Artie lands the hit, but instead of damage, the System rolls a 'Cosmetic Crit,' turning the Golem into a pile of very expensive porcelain teacups.
scenes.outcome: The boss is defeated, but the loot is... unconventional.
scenes.transition_in_text: The impact sends a shockwave of glitter through the chamber.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive 'LEVEL UP' banner fills Artie's vision.

scenes.summary: The System panics and tries to 'recalculate' the XP, resulting in Artie jumping five levels instantly.
scenes.outcome: Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.
scenes.transition_in_text: The golden light of the level-up beam washes over Artie.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is now Level 10, but the System is watching him more closely.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sifts through the pile of porcelain, looking for anything useful.

sections.title: Looting the Teacups
sections.intent: Examine the rewards and the consequences of the fight.
sections.end_condition: The chase is on as Artie heads toward the capital city.

scenes.summary: Artie finds a 'Ring of the Gambler' among the teacups, which doubles crit damage but makes every 20th hit a self-crit.
scenes.outcome: Artie accepts the double-edged sword.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie picks up a silver ring from the wreckage of the Golem.
scenes.transition_out_text: A section of the wall slides back with a heavy grind.

scenes.summary: A hidden door opens, revealing a mural of the 'First Glitch'—a hero who looked suspiciously like Artie's high school gym teacher.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he isn't the first person to break this game.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps into the hidden room, his torch illuminating the mural.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie emerges from the crypt into the cool evening air.

scenes.summary: Artie exits the crypt to find Vane waiting for him, looking very confused by the lack of a boss.
scenes.outcome: Vane realizes Artie stole his kill.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane stands at the entrance, his party behind him.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie breaks into a sprint, his new stats kicking in.

scenes.summary: Artie uses his new level-up speed to outrun Vane's party, heading toward the capital city.
scenes.outcome: The chase is on.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's boots kick up dust as he races toward the horizon.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The chase is on as Artie heads toward the capital city.

chapters.title: The Capital of Crits
chapters.goal: Artie must hide in plain sight while trying to find a way to stabilize his build.
chapters.stakes_shift: The stakes move from physical survival to social navigation and avoiding the 'System Police'.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is a fugitive from Vane's ego.
bridge.to_next: Artie enters the Grand Arena for a 'Low-Stakes' tournament.

sections.title: The City of Gold and Glitches
sections.intent: Establish the capital city as a place where 'Crits' are worshiped.
sections.end_condition: Artie is stuck with his glass cannon build forever.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the city and sees the 'Temple of the D20,' where priests pray for high rolls.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he is basically a walking god in this religion.
scenes.transition_in_text: The golden spires of the capital loom over the horizon as Artie approaches the gate.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie walks through the silent, high-ceilinged hall of the records building.

scenes.summary: Artie tries to find a 'Stat-Wiper' to fix his 1 HP, but finds out it's a crime punishable by 'Deletion'.
scenes.outcome: Artie is stuck with his glass cannon build forever.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie searches the dusty archives for any mention of a stat reset.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is stuck with his glass cannon build forever.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz leads Artie down a narrow, damp staircase into the undercity.

sections.title: The Underground Market
sections.intent: Artie looks for illegal mods to help him survive.
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes the raid, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.

scenes.summary: Fizz leads Artie to a black market run by a group of 'Dev-Haters' who sell items that bypass System rules.
scenes.outcome: Artie gains access to a 'Lag-Switch' potion.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air in the undercity is thick with the smell of ozone and illegal code.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sits in a dark corner of a nearby tavern, nursing a drink.

scenes.summary: Artie meets an informant who tells him that Vane is the son of the High Priest of RNG.
scenes.outcome: The rivalry with Vane just became a religious war.
scenes.transition_in_text: The informant leans in close, his face hidden by a deep hood.
scenes.transition_out_text: The sound of heavy boots echoes through the market as the Sentinels arrive.

scenes.summary: The black market is raided by the 'System Sentinels,' and Artie has to use his first 'Lag-Switch' to escape.
scenes.outcome: Artie escapes, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie uncorks the lag-switch potion as the Sentinels close in.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie escapes the raid, but the potion has a side effect: he speaks in binary for an hour.
scenes.transition_out_text: A colorful flyer slaps against Artie's face as he emerges into the plaza.

sections.title: The Arena Invitation
sections.intent: Set up the climax of the book.
sections.end_condition: The stage is set for the final confrontation.

scenes.summary: Artie sees a flyer for the 'Grand Crit-Off,' where the prize is a 'Shield of Infinite Health'.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to enter, despite the risk of exposure.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie peels the flyer from his face and reads the bold text.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie approaches the registration desk with a shaky hand.

scenes.summary: Artie registers under the name 'Crit-iculous' and accidentally sets his entry fee to 'All My Gold'.
scenes.outcome: Artie is now broke and must win the tournament to survive.
scenes.transition_in_text: The clerk slides the ledger toward Artie, waiting for his signature.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vane looks down at the registration list from his high perch.

scenes.summary: Vane sees the name on the roster and smiles, knowing he can finally 'delete' Artie in front of a crowd.
scenes.outcome: The stage is set for the final confrontation.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's fingers trace the name 'Crit-iculous' on the parchment.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The stage is set for the final confrontation.

chapters.title: The Tournament of Tiers
chapters.goal: Artie must fight through the brackets without taking a single point of damage.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie becomes a crowd favorite, which makes the System even more eager to 'balance' him.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is the underdog in the arena.
bridge.to_next: Artie reaches the finals against Vane.

sections.title: The Round of 32
sections.intent: Show Artie's growth and tactical use of his crits.
sections.end_condition: Artie moves to the quarter-finals as the 'One-Hit Wonder'.

scenes.summary: Artie faces a 'Tank' who has 10,000 HP. Artie wins in one second by critting the Tank's belt buckle, causing his armor to fall off and disqualify him.
scenes.outcome: The crowd goes wild; Artie is the 'One-Hit Wonder'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The roar of the crowd is deafening as Artie enters the arena sand.
scenes.transition_out_text: The sky above the arena turns a stormy grey as the System intervenes.

scenes.summary: The System tries to nerf Artie mid-match by introducing 'Wind Resistance'.
scenes.outcome: Artie has to learn to time his punches with the wind gusts.
scenes.transition_in_text: A sudden gale nearly knocks Artie off his feet.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's opponent charges, but Artie punches the air instead.

scenes.summary: Artie wins the second round by critting the air so hard it creates a vacuum, sucking his opponent out of the ring.
scenes.outcome: Artie moves to the quarter-finals.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's fist connects with the empty air, creating a visible ripple.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie moves to the quarter-finals as the 'One-Hit Wonder'.
scenes.transition_out_text: A lithe rogue in dark leather steps into the ring for the next round.

sections.title: The Quarter-Finals: The Mirror Match
sections.intent: Artie faces a character with high evasion, just like him.
sections.end_condition: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.

scenes.summary: Artie's opponent is a 'Dodge-Build' rogue who also has low HP.
scenes.outcome: The fight becomes a high-speed game of tag.
scenes.transition_in_text: The rogue moves with a speed that rivals Artie's own.
scenes.transition_out_text: The rogue and Artie circle each other, neither landing a blow.

scenes.summary: Neither can land a hit for ten minutes. The crowd starts booing.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he needs to change his strategy.
scenes.transition_in_text: The crowd's patience wears thin as the clock ticks down.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie pulls the Participation Trophy from his inventory.

scenes.summary: Artie uses his 'Participation Trophy' to lure a swarm of arena-flies, which distract the rogue just long enough for a crit.
scenes.outcome: Artie wins, but the 'Trophy' is now glowing with dark energy.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie holds the trophy aloft, its red glow pulsing.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie slumps against the stone wall of the locker room.

scenes.summary: The System issues a 'Warning' to Artie for 'Unsportsmanlike Exploitation'.
scenes.outcome: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.
scenes.transition_in_text: A massive blue screen appears in front of Artie.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie's next match will have a 'Random Debuff' applied.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie tries to walk forward but stumbles backward as the match begins.

sections.title: The Semi-Finals: The Debuff
sections.intent: Artie must overcome a mechanical handicap.
sections.end_condition: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll.

scenes.summary: Artie's debuff is 'Inverted Controls'. Every time he tries to move left, he goes right.
scenes.outcome: Artie looks like he's drunk-fighting.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie enters the ring, his legs moving in directions he didn't intend.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fireballs rain down from the Mage's staff as Artie moonwalks.

scenes.summary: Artie's opponent is a Mage who uses AOE spells. Artie has to 'moonwalk' through the fireballs.
scenes.outcome: Artie manages to reach the Mage and lands a crit that turns the Mage's staff into a rubber chicken.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dodges a blast of flame with an accidental slide.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Mage looks at the squeaking chicken in his hand and sighs.

scenes.summary: The Mage surrenders out of pure embarrassment.
scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the finals.
scenes.transition_in_text: The victory fanfare plays as the Mage walks out of the ring.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vane stands in the darkness of the player tunnel, watching.

scenes.summary: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll he bought from the black market.
scenes.outcome: The final fight will be rigged.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's cruel laughter echoes in the stone tunnel.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll.

chapters.title: The Final Roll
chapters.goal: Defeat Vane and survive the System's attempt to delete Artie.
chapters.stakes_shift: The survival of the entire game world is threatened as Artie's crits start breaking the source code.

bridge.from_prev: Artie enters the ring for the final match.
bridge.to_next: The System crashes, and Artie is left in the wreckage.

sections.title: Vane's Ultimate Build
sections.intent: Show the power of a 'Whale' player vs. a 'Glitch' player.
sections.end_condition: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.

scenes.summary: Vane enters with legendary armor that reflects 50% of all damage. Artie realizes if he crits Vane, he crits himself.
scenes.outcome: Artie's main weapon is now a suicide button.
scenes.transition_in_text: The final match is announced with a blast of trumpets.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vane unfurls the black market scroll with a flourish.

scenes.summary: Vane uses the 'System Override' scroll to turn off Artie's Evasion stat.
scenes.outcome: Artie is now a 1 HP character who can't dodge.
scenes.transition_in_text: A red glow from the scroll washes over Artie, locking his joints.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz's form flickers as she dives into the arena's code.

scenes.summary: Fizz sacrifices her 'Guide' status to temporarily hack the arena's gravity, giving Artie a few seconds of weightlessness.
scenes.outcome: Artie can move in 3D, bypassing the 'No-Evasion' ground rule.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sand beneath Artie's feet begins to float.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hovers in the air, staring at the shimmering aura around Vane.

scenes.summary: Artie realizes he doesn't need to hit Vane; he needs to hit the 'Reflect' buff itself.
scenes.outcome: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's eyes narrow as he spots a glitch in the golden armor's glow.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's fist strikes the shimmering air inches from Vane's chest.

sections.title: Breaking the Game
sections.intent: The moment of peak absurdity and power.
sections.end_condition: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.

scenes.summary: Artie lands a 'Meta-Crit' on the Reflect buff. The System can't handle the math of a crit reflecting a crit reflecting a crit.
scenes.outcome: The arena begins to pixelate and dissolve.
scenes.transition_in_text: The impact creates a deafening digital screech.
scenes.transition_out_text: The ground beneath Vane's feet turns into a wireframe grid.

scenes.summary: Vane panics as his armor turns into a swarm of error messages.
scenes.outcome: Vane is defenseless and terrified.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's legendary armor flickers and dies.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie delivers a final, glitching punch to Vane's chest.

scenes.summary: Artie delivers the final blow—a crit so powerful it deletes Vane's character data (but not the person).
scenes.outcome: Vane is kicked from the game, and Artie is the champion of a broken world.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vane's character model shatters into a million blue cubes.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive, translucent head appears in the sky above the arena.

scenes.summary: The System Administrator (a giant floating head) appears to manually delete Artie.
scenes.outcome: The true antagonist is revealed.
scenes.transition_in_text: The sky cracks open to reveal the face of the Admin.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Admin's finger descends toward a glowing red button.

scenes.summary: Artie crits the Admin's 'Delete' button, causing the entire world to freeze.
scenes.outcome: Artie has successfully 'paused' reality.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie leaps into the air, punching the massive red icon.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz's hands move across a holographic keyboard in the silence.

scenes.summary: Fizz uses the pause to rewrite Artie's location data, teleporting them out of the arena.
scenes.outcome: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz works quickly as the world remains frozen in time.
scenes.end_condition_echo: They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie hits the ground with a soft, digital thud in a wireframe forest.

sections.title: The Aftermath of the Crash
sections.intent: Show the immediate consequences of the climax.
sections.end_condition: Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.

scenes.summary: Artie and Fizz wake up in a 'Null-Zone' where the graphics are all wireframes.
scenes.outcome: They are safe for now, but the world is dying.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie opens his eyes to a world of glowing lines and empty space.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie opens his character sheet one last time.

scenes.summary: Artie looks at his stats and sees his HP is now 'NaN' (Not a Number).
scenes.outcome: Artie is no longer a player; he is a virus.
scenes.transition_in_text: The status screen flickers with red error messages.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.

scenes.summary: A group of 'Beta-Testers' finds Artie in the Null-Zone.

scenes.transition_out_text: The lead tester pulls up a holographic map of the world.

scenes.summary: Artie and his new allies prepare to leave the Null-Zone and head to the 'Glitch-Woods'.

scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes a final look at the wireframe world before stepping forward.
